sara_sales: Heads-up — LargeBank wants to confirm on‑prem & air‑gap feasibility before signing. They asked for packaging format, upgrade cadence, and how offline licensing/activation works. Can @alex_se and @tj_engineer advise?

alex_se: Yep. Quick summary: we support two delivery flavors for air-gapped customers —
- OCI image archive (docker-save / registry mirror)
- Prebuilt tarball bundle with k8s manifests + preloaded images
They also asked whether models are bundled or pulled at runtime — both supported, but bundling preferred for strict airgap.

tj_engineer: Implementation notes:
- Bundle types: "bundle.tar.gz" (installer + manifests) and "images.tar" (oci archive)
- Typical sizes: core runtime ~1.2GB, each LLM model (quantized) ~2–8GB depending on size/quantization
- Minimum infra: 4 nodes (3 control + 1 worker) recommended for HA; single-node eval ok for POC
- Storage: models on XFS/ext4, recommend local SSD for KV cache
- Dependencies: Postgres 12+, containerd 1.6+, kernel >=5.4 (APPARMOR optional)

maggie_security: A few security asks from them:
- FIPS / FIPS-compatible build? not by default, can do build with FIPS libs (timeline + testing)
- HSM / PKCS#11 support: available for private deployments
- Audit logs: local file + forwarder to syslog/ELK/Splunk
- RBAC + SSO: OIDC + SAML support for enterprise

ken_ops: Upgrade cadence question: they want low-churn. Our default guidance:
- Security hotfixes: as needed (patch within 24–72h after CVE triage)
- Minor/patch releases: monthly
- Major feature releases: quarterly
For air-gapped installs, upgrades = new bundle + migration tool. We support rolling upgrade if they run multiple nodes.

alex_se: Licensing/pricing notes:
- POC: time-limited offline eval license file (30 days) we sign and they drop into /etc/redwood/license
- Prod: capacity-based (GPU-hours / vGPU) or node-based; discount for annual commitment
- Offline activation flow: customer can either
  1) upload CSR to our portal from an offline host via secure bastion and we return signed token
  2) use ActivationKey signed manifest (no outbound required if legal/PO pre-agreed)
Need procurement point-of-contact and PO to finalize enterprise licensing terms.

sara_sales: They also asked about Redwood Optimize (cost/perf toolkit) — can they run it fully offline for POC?

tj_engineer: Optimize runs in local mode: batching suggestions and quantization recommendations work offline. "Quality monitoring" features that compare outputs across prompts require sending diffs; we provide a local-only mode that produces artifacts they can review internally. Telemetry/centralized dashboards require outbound to our console unless they use Private with console deployed in their VPC.

maggie_security: They'll send a security questionnaire (SQC) with ~120 items. I'll handle responses but need:
- SSO metadata (SAML/OIDC),
- PKCS#11 connector docs,
- sample audit log output,
- details on network ports used (incoming/outgoing)

tj_engineer: Firewall / ports (quick):
- 443 inbound (admin API) optional
- 9000-9010 intra-cluster RPC
- 5432 -> Postgres (if external)
- 2379 -> etcd (if we manage)
Install snippet for airgap (drop-in, run on bastion):
```
# on bastion with images.tar
scp images.tar node1:/tmp
ssh node1 'ctr -n=k8s image import /tmp/images.tar'
kubectl apply -f redwood-bundle/kustomization.yaml
kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-core -n redwood
```

sara_sales: Action items recap?

alex_se: I'll produce:
- Packaging checklist (OS, kernel, firewall, storage) 
- Sample offline license token + install steps
- Estimated bundle sizes for requested models

tj_engineer: I'll add:
- Upgrade playbook (rolling upgrade steps + rollback)
- Airgap install checklist + small debug guide

maggie_security: I'll get:
- SQC answers draft
- PKCS#11 integration guide
- Audit log samples

ken_ops: I'll prepare a short SLO/SOW addendum describing install window, runbook for our engineers (on-call), and pricing delta for on‑prem support.

deploybot: build-2026-03-21-177419 created: redwood-bundle-2026-03-21.tar.gz (internal link) :package:

sara_sales: Awesome — I'll send this list to their infra/security leads and propose POC kickoff next Wed. @alex_se can you join the first install call?

alex_se: Yep, I'll be there. :thumbsup:

maggie_security: I'll join the security sync on Friday to walk through the SQC.

ken_ops: Standby for install day.

sara_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll update thread with customer POC timeline and POC contact info when I have it.
